svg.title: Occupational therapist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as occupational therapist, wearing a care tunic. Visible work cue: A large adapted drinking cup has two easy-grip handles and an open supporting hand below it. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face and round glasses.
